data.name: Ibaadoon
data.gender_notes: Ibaadoon is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘ibaada’, meaning ‘to serve’ or ‘to worship’. This name signifies a deep commitment to serving and worshiping Allah. The name Ibaadoon carries the meaning “Servants of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ibaadoon usually hope their child will grow to embody servants of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who are constantly in a state of spiritual devotion and service to Allah
data.etymology: Ibaadoon belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servants of Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ibaadoon total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
